summary_ja: 購入債権の款で用いるEL及びデフォルト・リスクの意義を定める。
summary_en: Defines EL and default risk for the purposes of the Subsection on purchased receivables.
paragraphs: In this Subsection, "EL" means the expected loss rate, corresponding to the default risk portion, relative to the total amount of exposures included in a pool of purchased receivables.
In this Subsection, "default risk" means the risk that purchased receivables will default.
